# schlaflos

> schlaflos is a macOS command-line tool that keeps a Mac awake during configured
> time windows or while selected processes run, and reserves wake events so the
> Mac is up when the window starts. A root LaunchDaemon runs `schlaflos reconcile`
> every poll interval; each run reads a TOML configuration, evaluates a pure
> policy, and applies the minimum change to `pmset disablesleep` and the pmset
> wake schedule. Typical use: a Mac that acts as a self-hosted CI runner during
> the day and sleeps normally otherwise.

This file is for AI assistants helping a person configure or operate schlaflos.
Everything needed to write a valid configuration is below; the linked documents
explain the design in depth.

## What an assistant can do

- Write or edit `schlaflos.toml` from a description such as "keep it awake on
  weekdays 9 to 18, wake it at 8:55, and let a running GitHub Actions job
  finish". Validate with `schlaflos config check PATH` (no root needed).
- Explain the current state from `schlaflos status --json` (readable without
  root) or `schlaflos doctor`.
- Tell the person which command to run next. Commands that change the system
  need `sudo`: `install`, `config apply`, `emergency-off`, `uninstall`,
  `reconcile`.

Never put credentials, tokens, or environment values into the configuration;
the schema has no place for them and unknown keys are rejected.

## Policy in one line

```text
prevent_sleep = (on AC power OR require_ac = false)
                AND (inside a window OR a process guard matches a running process)
```

When `prevent_sleep` is false the Mac returns to its pre-install `disablesleep`
value (the baseline), which is normally 0. A Mac on battery with
`require_ac = true` is never kept awake, even by a matching process.

## Configuration schema (TOML, version 1)

Unknown keys anywhere are errors. All keys:

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | integer | yes | - | must be `1` |
| `poll_interval` | duration string | no | `"30s"` | whole seconds, `5s`..`1h`; also the launchd StartInterval |
| `power.require_ac` | bool | no | `true` | `true` = never inhibit sleep on battery |
| `windows` | array of tables | no | none | zero or more `[[windows]]` |
| `windows[].days` | array of strings | yes | - | lowercase `mon tue wed thu fri sat sun`, no duplicates, non-empty; the day the window **starts** |
| `windows[].start` | `"HH:MM"` | yes | - | 24-hour, inclusive |
| `windows[].end` | `"HH:MM"` | yes | - | 24-hour, exclusive; `end <= start` means the window crosses midnight into the next day; `end == start` is an error |
| `wake.enabled` | bool | no | `false` | enables the recurring pmset wake |
| `wake.days` | array of strings | when enabled | - | same format as window days |
| `wake.time` | `"HH:MM"` | when enabled | - | daily wake time (`pmset repeat`) |
| `wake.action` | string | no | `"wakeorpoweron"` | `wakeorpoweron`, `wake`, or `poweron` |
| `wake.interval` | duration string | no | off | whole minutes, `5m`..`12h`; reserves extra one-off wake events every interval inside each window for the next 24 h; requires at least one window |
| `guards.process` | array of tables | no | none | zero or more `[[guards.process]]` |
| `guards.process[].name` | string | yes | - | `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}`, unique; shown in status |
| `guards.process[].executable` | string | yes | - | absolute, clean path; compared exactly with the executable path of running processes (`ps -axo pid=,comm=`); never executed |

Times use the Mac's local time zone and follow its daylight-saving rules.
Overlapping windows are allowed and act as a union.

## Examples

Self-hosted CI runner, awake 08:00-20:00 every day on AC, wake at 08:00, and let
a job that is still running at 20:00 finish:

```toml
version = 1
poll_interval = "30s"

[power]
require_ac = true

[[windows]]
days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun"]
start = "08:00"
end = "20:00"

[wake]
enabled = true
days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun"]
time = "08:00"
action = "wakeorpoweron"

[[guards.process]]
name = "github-actions-job"
executable = "/Users/ci/actions-runner/bin/Runner.Worker"
```

Weekdays only, with hourly wake events so a Mac that fell asleep (missed wake,
manual sleep, AC unplugged and later restored) is back within an hour:

```toml
version = 1

[[windows]]
days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
start = "09:00"
end = "18:00"

[wake]
enabled = true
days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
time = "08:55"
interval = "1h"
```

Overnight batch window Friday 22:00 to Saturday 06:00 (the day names the start):

```toml
version = 1

[[windows]]
days = ["fri"]
start = "22:00"
end = "06:00"
```

Keep the Mac awake only while a process runs, no schedule at all:

```toml
version = 1

[power]
require_ac = false

[[guards.process]]
name = "render"
executable = "/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender"
```

Wake reservation only, never inhibit sleep:

```toml
version = 1

[wake]
enabled = true
days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
time = "07:30"
```

Finding a process executable path on the Mac:

```sh
ps -axo pid=,comm= | grep -i runner.worker
```

## Commands

```text
schlaflos init [PATH]                      write the example configuration (default ./schlaflos.toml)
schlaflos config check PATH                validate; prints the parsed windows, wake, and guards
schlaflos status [--json]                  last reconciliation: request, observed disablesleep, reason, next transition, wake state
schlaflos doctor                           invariants, freshness, drift; root adds config/launchd/ledger checks
sudo schlaflos install --config PATH [--replace-wake-schedule]
sudo schlaflos config apply PATH [--replace-wake-schedule]
sudo schlaflos emergency-off               force disablesleep=0, release owned wake events, unload; keeps config
sudo schlaflos uninstall                   restore pre-install values still owned by schlaflos, remove everything
sudo schlaflos reconcile [--dry-run]       one reconciliation now (launchd runs this every poll interval)
schlaflos version
```

`--replace-wake-schedule` is needed only when an unrelated recurring
`pmset repeat` schedule already exists; the install refuses otherwise and
prints the existing schedule.

## Reading status

`schlaflos status --json` fields: `requested` (schlaflos wants sleep inhibited),
`observed` (actual disablesleep), `reason` (`scheduled_window`,
`active_process_guard`, `battery_power`, `outside_window`,
`invalid_configuration`, `power_source_unknown`), `power_source`,
`inside_window`, `active_guards`, `next_transition`, `wake_installed`,
`wake_observed`, `wake_events_scheduled`, `next_wake_event`, `conflicts`
(`sleep_setting_drift`, `wake_schedule_drift`), `degraded`
(`process_inspection_failed`), `last_transition`, `last_error` (category only),
`run_ok`.

`requested = false` with `observed = true` means the pre-install baseline was
already `disablesleep = 1`; schlaflos preserves it.

## Facts that matter when advising

- Inside a window `disablesleep = 1` blocks idle sleep and lid-close sleep. It
  does not block a manual Sleep from the Apple menu or `pmset sleepnow`.
- A sleeping Mac cannot run reconciliation; wake reservations are the only
  local recovery. `wake.time` is the durable daily anchor, `wake.interval`
  the retry inside the window.
- Removing AC with `require_ac = true` drops the request within one poll
  interval; the Mac then sleeps per its battery timer and comes back at the
  next reserved wake if AC is present again.
- macOS allows one recurring pmset wake; schlaflos manages that pair as a
  whole and records the previous one to restore on uninstall.
- Files: `/Library/Application Support/schlaflos/config.toml` (installed
  config, root-only), `/var/db/schlaflos/status.json` (world-readable),
  `/var/log/schlaflos.log` (reconciler log), LaunchDaemon label
  `io.github.nozomemein.schlaflos`.
- Not supported in v1: Linux/Windows, remote control, hooks or scripts, more
  than one recurring pmset schedule.
